abstract.t: This document specifies host behavior enabling IPv4 communication for dual-stack hosts on IPv6-only segments, without IPv4 subnets, ARP, tunneling, or translation. A host is provisioned by ordinary DHCPv4 or by static configuration. Where its IPv4 default gateway is a reserved sentinel address, the host resolves the next-hop link-layer address from the IPv6 neighbor cache rather than by ARP. IPv4 packets are forwarded natively, end to end. The mechanism is incrementally deployable alongside unmodified hosts; no flag day or mandatory switch-over point is needed. This document requests the allocation of one IPv4 address from 192.0.0.0/24 in the IANA IPv4 Special-Purpose Address Registry.
